title: Card Track-Record Allowance on the Debit-Card Ceiling, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Cashiering standard clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the track-record allowance of the debit-card ceiling of the day, earned by recent card payments that have never come back.

## Clause

The debit-card ceiling's track-record allowance is:
- **$500.00** where 3 or more card payments, debit or credit, were received in the last three months and no card payment on the account was ever returned;
- **$250.00** where at least one but fewer than 3 card payments were received in the last three months and no card payment on the account was ever returned;
- **nothing** where no card payment was received in the last three months, or a card payment on the account was ever returned.

The allowance is added, at its full amount, to the amount from which the payments counted against the debit-card ceiling are subtracted.

## Reading the conditions

- *Card payments in the last three months* are the debit-card and credit-card consumer payments posted on the account whose date is fewer than three whole calendar months before the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month. On a handling date of 2026-10-10, a payment of 2026-07-11 is inside the window and one of 2026-07-10 is not.
- *A card payment ever returned* means any returned-payment entry on the account, at any date, for a debit-card or credit-card payment. A returned bank-debit, check or money-order payment does not count here.

## Condition table

| Card payments in the last three months | A card payment on the account ever returned | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | No | $500.00 |
| 1 or 2 | No | $250.00 |
| 0 | No | nothing |
| any number | Yes | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented histories, handling date 2026-10-10.*

- Debit-card payments on 2026-07-20, 2026-08-20 and 2026-09-20; no card payment ever returned. Three card payments: allowance $500.00.
- One credit-card payment on 2026-09-01 and a bank-debit payment returned in 2025; no card return ever. One card payment, and the returned payment was not a card payment: allowance $250.00.
- Four card payments in the last three months, but a debit-card payment from 2024 was charged back. Allowance nothing.
